changelog:
Initial release of tg-search.

- Search public Telegram channels and groups by keyword.
- Uses your existing authorized Telethon session.
- Returns up to 50 results as JSON objects with type, title, username, and ID.
- Supports both English and non-English queries.
- Only finds public, searchable channels and groups.
summary: Search public Telegram channels and groups by keyword, returning up to 50 matching results as JSON using an authorized Telethon session.
